name: JellyPlug Cache Headers
description: Long-lived Cache-Control on the version-busted /JavaScriptInjector/*.js and the build-hashed /web/* bundles, 1h + ETag on /Branding/Css, and high-quality brotli/gzip so wire size beats the server's on-the-fly compression.
overview: Makes JellyPlug's heavy CSS/JS assets cacheable so the app loads fast on reload.

versions.changelog: 1.2.0.0 (JELA-714): build-hashed /web/* bundles (bare hex query) now public, max-age=604800, immutable when the query equals the CURRENT build hash read from <web>/index.html, else public, max-age=0, must-revalidate; strong SHA-256 ETag with self-answered 304s (conditional headers stripped downstream so the static handler cannot 304 header-less); Vary: Accept-Encoding, Origin on /web/ (M63 cache-mode collision); .html never matched — index.html keeps no-cache.

1.1.1.0 (JELA-76): ?v=-busted /JavaScriptInjector/*.js now max-age=604800 immutable (incl. empty private.js); /Branding/Css public, max-age=3600 + ETag (URL has no cache-buster in jellyfin-web); middleware compresses itself (brotli q11 / gzip 9, cached per content version) instead of the server's Fastest-level on-the-fly compression.
1.0.0.0 (JEL-659): stamp ETag + Cache-Control on the two uncached JellyPlug assets and answer conditional GETs with 304.
